end.summary:
Discussed uses of non-metals: oxygen, chlorine, iodine, hydrogen and carbon.
Pari explained oxygen supports breathing and burning, and chlorine kills germs in water.
Pari identified iodised salt as a source of iodine and linked it with preventing goitre.
Hydrogen as rocket fuel and oxygen supporting combustion were clarified; teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the uses of non-metals through examples and questioning. Pari explained chlorine in water, iodised salt, and oxygen for breathing and burning; the hydrogen-versus-oxygen rocket example was mixed up at first and corrected later by stating that hydrogen is the fuel and oxygen supports its burning. At home, you can ask Pari to make a small two-column list of non-metals and one use for each, including oxygen, chlorine, iodine, hydrogen and carbon.
